name: Michelangelo Hand
def: Robotic prosthetic hand with full articulation made by the German company Ottobock with its American partner Advanced Arm Dynamics, the first prosthesis with an electronically driven thumb.
facts: First fitted to an Austrian elective amputee in July 2010
Used by military and civilian amputees in the United States and United Kingdom since 2011
Its thumb movement imitates that of a natural human hand
